fact: The Ministry of Technology, Communication and Innovation issued the National Open Data Policy in May 2017, prepared with the Central Informatics Bureau, the Data Protection Office and the Attorney General's Office, setting 'open by default' for public datasets and adopting the CC BY 4.0 licence; the document carries no end date.
The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that Mauritius has an open data portal, linked as data.govmu.org; the line gives no launch year, so this is dated to the 2025 survey round.
